---
title: "An Example of a Quarto Website"
subtitle: "STAT 206 (MSBA)"
---

## Requirements

- Quarto
- Conda/Micromamba
- GitHub repository with GitHub Pages
- Grit

## Packages

See `environment.yml` for the latest version.
At the time of writing, the file had the following information:


```{text}
name: quarto_web
channels:
  - conda-forge
dependencies:
  - python=3.14
  - ipykernel
  - jupyter
  - matplotlib
  - pandas
  - seaborn
  - statsmodels
```
